title: GeVIR - Gene Variation Intolerance Rank
description: Gene-level intolerance-to-variation ranks for 19,361 protein-coding genes, derived from the density and spatial distribution of protein-coding variants observed across ~138,632 gnomAD exome and genome sequences. The GeVIR percentile ranks genes by intolerance to functional variation; VIRLoF combines GeVIR with the gnomAD LOEUF loss-of-function constraint metric. This is a gene-level resource keyed by Ensembl gene_id and is build-agnostic; the underlying gnomAD data is v2 (GRCh37). It is not a variant-level pathogenicity score.

files.description: Per-gene GeVIR and VIRLoF intolerance percentile ranks (~19,361 protein-coding genes)
